crossRefs.note: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints…
but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return…
Now after these things had ended, Paul determined in the Spirit, when he had passed through Macedonia and Achaia, to go…
For Paul had determined to sail past Ephesus, that he might not have to spend time in Asia; for he was hastening, if it…
Now, behold, I go bound by the Spirit to Jerusalem, not knowing what will happen to me there;
Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;
Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.
translations.bsb: Now, however, I am on my way to Jerusalem to serve the saints there.
translations.kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
translations.asv: but now, I say, I go unto Jerusalem, ministering unto the saints.
